The '''HV-7 loading droid''' was a small hovering utility [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that utilized [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] technology to lift heavy loads, eliminating the need for the huge bulk-loader droids used previously. They could fold up into a disc, which made them take up less space.<ref name="LECG" />

Popular amongst [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], these droids helped [[Baktoid Industrial Systems/Legends|Baktoid Industrial Systems]] reinvent its image after Baktoid's role in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="LECG" /> During the [[Second Imperial Civil War]] in [[137 ABY]] several units stationed on [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards|Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyard]],<ref name="Legacy 2006 20">[[Legacy (2006) 20|''Legacy'' (2006) 20]]</ref>
